title: Quantum Weight Reduction with Layer Codes
summary: Quantum weight reduction procedures ease the implementation of quantum codes by sparsifying them, resulting in low-weight checks and low-degree qubits. However, to date, only few quantum weight reduction methods have been explored. In this work we introduce a simple and general procedure for quantum weight reduction that achieves check weight 6 and total qubit degree 6, lower than existing procedures at the cost of a potentially larger qubit overhead.
